name: limberpix
description: Pixel-art sprite animation skills for Claude Code: find and repair what a generated sprite sheet loses between frames, animate creatures from one drawing, and check the motion before anyone sees it.

plugins.name: limberpix
plugins.description: Two skills for pixel-art sprite animation: pixel-anim-check (find and repair what a generated sheet loses between frames, and a measured check for broken motion, with a contact sheet and GIF) and pixel-animate (a method to animate creatures from one drawing, with a body-part cutter).
